title: Putin Ally Warns West of 'Start of Real War' as US Envoys Shuttle Between Moscow and Kyiv
detail: Russia escalates rhetoric as a senior Putin ally warns the West of the 'start of real war.' US envoys continue shuttle diplomacy between Moscow and Kyiv. Russia separately accuses Germany of Nazism and rejects drone strike accusations. The Kremlin confirms Anchorage summit framework elements remain on the peace agenda.
